b1-rakosikorszak-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The End of Free Elections
b1-rakosikorszak-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks which party won the free election of 1945 and how the communists got rid of the other parties.
b1-rakosikorszak-01.prompt: Tell the examiner which party won in 1945 and what the communists did to the opposition parties.
cues: Say which party won the free election of 1945
Say how the communists removed the opposition parties
b1-rakosikorszak-01.target: 1945-ben a Független Kisgazdapárt nyerte a választást. A kommunisták szalámitaktikával számolták fel az ellenzéki pártokat.
b1-rakosikorszak-01.english: In 1945 the Independent Smallholders' Party won the election. The communists dismantled the opposition parties with salami tactics.
b1-rakosikorszak-01.canDo: I can explain how the communists removed the opposition parties one by one between 1945 and 1948.

b1-rakosikorszak-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rákosi's Cult
b1-rakosikorszak-02.scenario: Your Hungarian teacher is going through the citizenship topics with you. She asks what happened in 1949 and how the propaganda named Rákosi.
b1-rakosikorszak-02.prompt: Tell your teacher what came into being in 1949 and how the propaganda named Rákosi.
cues: Say what came into being in 1949
Say what the propaganda called Rákosi
b1-rakosikorszak-02.target: A sztálini alkotmány 1949-ben jött létre. A propaganda Rákosit Sztálin legjobb magyar tanítványának nevezte.
b1-rakosikorszak-02.english: The Stalinist constitution came into being in 1949. The propaganda called Rákosi Stalin's best Hungarian disciple.
b1-rakosikorszak-02.canDo: I can describe the one-party state and the cult of Mátyás Rákosi after 1949.

b1-rakosikorszak-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Black Cars
b1-rakosikorszak-03.scenario: On a museum visit at Andrássy út 60 in Budapest, the guide asks you where the ÁVH worked and why people dreaded the black cars.
b1-rakosikorszak-03.prompt: Tell the guide where the ÁVH worked and why people dreaded the black cars.
cues: Say why people dreaded the black cars
b1-rakosikorszak-03.target: Az ÁVH az Andrássy út 60-ban működött. Az emberek rettegtek a fekete autóktól, mert az ÁVH éjjel ezekkel hurcolta el az embereket.
b1-rakosikorszak-03.english: The ÁVH worked at Andrássy út 60. People dreaded the black cars because the ÁVH dragged people away in them at night.
b1-rakosikorszak-03.canDo: I can say what the ÁVH and Andrássy út 60 were.

b1-rakosikorszak-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Show Trials
b1-rakosikorszak-04.scenario: Your teacher asks you, as practice for the citizenship interview, what happened to Rajk and to Mindszenty in the show trials.
b1-rakosikorszak-04.prompt: Tell your teacher what the court did to Rajk and to Mindszenty.
cues: Say what the court did to Rajk
Say what the court did to Mindszenty
b1-rakosikorszak-04.target: Rajk Lászlót 1949-ben koholt vádak alapján ítélték halálra. Mindszenty József bíborost életfogytiglani börtönre ítélték.
b1-rakosikorszak-04.english: László Rajk was sentenced to death in 1949 on fabricated charges. Cardinal József Mindszenty was sentenced to life imprisonment.
b1-rakosikorszak-04.canDo: I can say what a show trial was and who Rajk and Mindszenty were.

b1-rakosikorszak-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Attic Sweeping
b1-rakosikorszak-05.scenario: At a museum exhibition about the 1950s, the guide asks you what the regime did to the wealthier farmers and what Sztálinváros was.
b1-rakosikorszak-05.prompt: Tell the guide how the regime treated the wealthier farmers and what Sztálinváros was.
cues: Say what the regime called the wealthier farmers
b1-rakosikorszak-05.target: A hatalom a módosabb gazdákat kulákoknak bélyegezte. Sztálinváros új szocialista város volt a puszta közepén.
b1-rakosikorszak-05.english: The regime branded the wealthier farmers kulaks. Sztálinváros was a new socialist town in the middle of the plain.
b1-rakosikorszak-05.canDo: I can say how the state treated the peasants in the early 1950s.

b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rákosi Era in Review
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks for a short summary of the Rákosi era for the citizenship interview.
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher what the ÁVH did at night and what happened to Rajk.
cues: Say what the ÁVH did at night
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.target: Az ÁVH éjjel hurcolta el az embereket. Rajk Lászlót koholt vádak alapján ítélték halálra.
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.english: The ÁVH dragged people away at night. László Rajk was sentenced to death on fabricated charges.
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.canDo: I can review the main events and people of the Rákosi era.
